newsitem.title: USA: Eurogas in methane pact with Texaco.
newsitem.headline: Eurogas in methane pact with Texaco.

text.p: Eurogas Inc said Thursday its Pol-Tex Methane Sp. z.o.o. unit entered an agreement with Texaco Slask Sp. z.o.o., a Polish affiliate of Texaco Inc, for Texaco to acquire the right to appraise and develop Eurogas' Pol-Tex coalbed methane gas concession 134-93.
The deal calls for Texaco to make an initial cash payment to Eurogas and conduct a substantial initial drilling program for appraisal purposes.
Eurogas controls major coalbed methane gas concessions in the Upper Silesian Coal basin in South Central Poland.

Texaco has the right to develop the concession in exchange for additional cash and payment of between 14 and 20 percent of the net profits, depending upon the cumulative gas production levels reached, Eurogas said in a press release.

Texaco also has the right of first refusal on Eurogas's two other coalbed methane gas concessions in Poland, known as the MMR and MMJ concessions. Eurogas said it intends to conduct development programs on these concessions this year.

Eurogas said it has been conducting discussions with a consortium of North American power companies to supply methane gas from the MMR and MMJ concessions for a proposed power plant that would be built on Eurogas' concession area.
The consortium is investigating the technical feasibility of building the 50-megawatt plant at an estimated cost of $50 million.
